kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنحبس (form VII)
# أَنْحَبِسُ (ʔanḥabisu) /ʔan.ħa.bi.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَبَسَ (inḥabasa)
# أَنْحَبِسَ (ʔanḥabisa) /ʔan.ħa.bi.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَبَسَ (inḥabasa)
# أَنْحَبِسْ (ʔanḥabis) /ʔan.ħa.bis/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَبَسَ (inḥabasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
